# JNJ — Catalysts

## TL;DR

The BofA Healthcare Conference on May 12 (~6 trading days) is the live near-term catalyst window — management could update on IMAAVY FDA Priority Review progress and Darzalex trajectory. Positive commentary could trigger short-covering. Analyst consensus Buy with avg PT ~$249 implies ~11% upside to current $224.07, but consensus has been wrong for 21 trading days while price fell from $240+. Next binary: Q2 2026 earnings (~July 15). Risk-off macro (Iran escalation + Fed hold) removes the defensive rotation bid that supported JNJ in prior risk-off episodes. Ongoing structural risks: talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) and Stelara biosimilar erosion. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260504_194523.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| BofA Healthcare Conference | May 12, 2026 | Watch — IMAAVY and Darzalex guidance; positive commentary triggers short-covering risk |
| RBC Capital Markets Global Healthcare Conference | May 19, 2026 | Second near-term appearance |
| Quarterly dividend | Ex-date May 26, 2026 | $1.34/share declared; income signal, not a price mover |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 15, 2026 | Next binary — analyst Q2 EPS est. ~$2.84; Stelara erosion rate vs Darzalex growth is the key read |
| IMAAVY FDA review decision | TBD (Priority Review granted) | Priority Review for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia; Vivacity-MG3 Phase 3 positive in myasthenia gravis |
| Talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) | Unscheduled | Largest unquantifiable binary — settlement or adverse ruling creates a gap |

## Recent news synthesis

**BofA Healthcare Conference May 12 confirmed** (announced April 21, 2026). JNJ also at RBC May 19. Both are near-term watch events for pipeline and guidance commentary. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Caplyta favorable efficacy data (May 4, 2026).** Network meta-analysis shows favorable outcomes vs approved antipsychotics for MDD add-on treatment, no significant weight gain. Pipeline positive; not a near-term price driver. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 14, 2026) — fully absorbed.** Revenue $24.1B (+10% YoY); Darzalex $4B vs $3.4B est.; Tremfya $1.6B vs $1.2B est.; GAAP net income fell 52.4% on talc reserve. Muted +0.5–1% reaction confirmed trapped-longs absorption. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Stelara biosimilar headwind — ongoing.** AbbVie and Amgen biosimilar launches are the primary competitive erosion; Royalty Pharma $500M Icotyde partnership is the recovery vehicle. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260504_194523.)

## Analyst consensus

Avg PT ~$249 (range $234–$285); 19 of 23 analysts Buy as of April 21, 2026. Current price $224.07 is ~11% below consensus — implied upside, but the confirmed downtrend reflects institutional disagreement with near-term timing. (Source: analyst_consensus, web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260504_194523.)

## Insider activity

No activity recorded. Absence of insider buying at a 21-trading-day low is a mild bear signal. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent, signals_combined.json, run 20260504_194523.)
